candidates.buyer: Villa owners, Airbnb hosts, small guest houses and the property managers or accountants who file for them (about 1,000+ listings per third-party data; official count unverified)

candidates.name: P01 Villa / short-term rental ABST and Tourism Guest Levy filing service
candidates.trigger: IRD Feb 2026 notice: ABST registration mandatory once providing accommodation for up to 45 days; ABST returns monthly, due 15th; Tourism Guest Levy Act No. 13 of 2021: levy US$3 or US$5 per guest per night, return within 21 days after each payment period, guest occupancy register; hotel association is pushing government to extend enforcement to villas.
candidates.unchecked: Official count of licensed villas; current levy rate and ABST rate for rentals (sources conflict: 10.5%, 14%, 17%); whether IRD offers an online portal (TAXRIS or similar); whether Airbnb collects and remits; Tourism Licensing and Classification Act licence renewals; willingness to pay; local-language search not applicable (English only).

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K02. Search found no domestic-worker-specific rule; Social Security/Medical Benefits employer registration is general. Rates in sources conflict (unverified).

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: One search returned no Antigua-specific scrap-metal licensing law (only NZ and Delaware). Unverified whether a regime exists.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Same search as cat. 2; no Antigua act found. Unverified.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: No dedicated search; AML duty for jewellers sits with ONDCP (see K05).

coverage.found: Budget; no dedicated search. Car dealers are covered in K05.

coverage.found: Budget; tiny market, no search.

coverage.found: Combined agriculture search found nothing on vet licensing. Unverified.

coverage.found: One search found no Antigua groundwater or well-drilling licensing law (results were Barbados and Ghana). Unverified.

coverage.found: Budget; no dedicated search.

coverage.found: Budget; no dedicated search.

coverage.found: No commodity trading sector of note in Antigua; not searched.

coverage.found: Co-operative Societies Act No. 9 of 2010 with a Supervisor of Co-operative Societies; 2001 Regulations require annual statements, audit and returns. About 8 credit unions per the Co-operative League. Too few buyers; weak candidate P04.

coverage.found: Budget; no search.

coverage.found: Pharmacy Act 1995, Pharmacy Regulations 2012, 2019 amendments; Pharmacy Council regulates about 25 pharmacies and 10 wholesalers. Too few buyers; weak candidate P05.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Search found no Antigua private-security licensing source (results were Barbados). Unverified.

coverage.found: Budget; no search.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Strongest lead: IRD Feb 2026 notice that villa, Airbnb and dual-purpose home operators must register for ABST (from up to 45 days of providing accommodation) and file monthly by the 15th; Tourism Guest Levy Act No. 13 of 2021 return within 21 days of each payment period, guest occupancy register required. Candidate P01.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K03; WTO import-licensing is run by the Trade Division. No export traceability duty found.

coverage.category: 31. Short-term rental / villa operators (Tourism Guest Levy Act 2021, ABST, Tourism Licensing and Classification Act)
coverage.found: See candidate P01.

coverage.found: Annual permit renewal, employer-initiated; a Feb 2026 Cabinet centralisation policy is reported by one secondary source only (VisaVerge). Candidate P02 weak/unverified.

coverage.category: 35. Data protection and beneficial-ownership registers
coverage.found: Data Protection Act 2013 found but no controller registration or deadline located and regulator operational status unclear. Beneficial ownership held by licensed registered agents. Candidate P06 weak.

coverage.found: One snippet says tour operators must collect full 17% ABST from 1 Sept 2026 (single secondary source, unverified). Candidate P09 weak.

coverage.found: One search found no relevant 2025 licensing gazette notice; gazette site is www.gazette.gov.ag (not fetched).
